title.narrative: Basma Project for the care of orphans and their families in Syria

description.narrative: 900 orphans receive cash sponsorship. 900 school bags are distributed. Clothing is provided to orphans through shopping vouchers.

Enhancing social and economic security, improving academic achievement, and reducing the vulnerability of orphans and their families in Syria through: - Protecting children from homelessness and begging and ensuring a safe and dignified life for them. - Returning them to school. - Alleviating the burden on struggling families or those hosting orphans.
